Iron Brooch

Internal ID: TrinketIronHealth | Type: Trinkets | Source: Forge | Crafting Materials: Iron x5, Ancient bark x5, Leech trophy x1 | Adrenaline Cost: 65 | Effect: +50 health gain | +20 armor | Duration: 30s

Introduction. Iron Brooch is Swamp-tier trinket.

Effects. Once 65 Adrenaline has been gained, the Iron Brooch will trigger automatically, providing 50 health immediately and 20 additional armor for 30 seconds.
